observed_full_episode_journal_secondary.interpretation: The historical acceptance journal preserves subsequently revoked HS; the retained-after-repairs matching and final counters are separate. HS cancellation records are repairs rather than physiological zero-duration stances. Actor-valid cycles remain distinct from binary events and agreement with measured contact; an unanchored startup TO remains an explicit extra against the complete-cycle oracle.

support_adapter: Recorded 1ms sensor support used for binary and actor transports; logical trace timestamps retained separately. No detector execution.
limitations: Measured healthy-limb20N nominal events are production references, not ground truth of the virtual prosthetic limb.
Binary geometry plane/points, empirical force basis/plane and renderedSTL sole are different constructions; timing disagreement does not uniquely identify registration error.
Actor counters and retained cycle events are algorithmic diagnostics, not independent physiological cycles.
All inherited tolerances are diagnostic pairing references only; no new acceptance, hardware, subject or gait gate.
